import numpy as np
hs={'A':lambda a:a,'A2':lambda a:a**2,'A3':lambda a:a**3,'expA':np.exp,'sqrtA':np.sqrt,'invA':lambda a:1/a,'lnA':np.log,'A1.5':lambda a:a**1.5,'A4':lambda a:a**4,'expmA':lambda a:np.exp(-a)}
edges=np.linspace(0.5,10.0001,13)
for n,h in hs.items():
    sse=0
    for i in range(len(edges)-1):
        m=(t>=edges[i])&(t<edges[i+1])
        X=np.column_stack([np.ones(m.sum()),t[m]*0+1,h(A[m])]) if False else np.column_stack([np.ones(m.sum()),t[m]-t[m].mean(),h(A[m])])
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dA_dt[m],rcond=None)
        sse+=np.sum((X@c-dA_dt[m])**2)
    print(n, sse/np.sum((dA_dt-dA_dt.mean())**2))

from scipy.optimize import least_squares
g=0.17325*np.exp(-0.18064*t)+0.014782*t*np.exp(-0.13295*t)

cands={
 'exp+te': (lambda p: p[0]-p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*t)+p[3]*t*np.exp(-p[4]*t), [2.7,1.6,1.4,1.3,0.13]),
 'a-b/(t+c)+d*t': (lambda p: p[0]-p[1]/(t+p[2])+p[3]*t, [7,10,2,0]),
 'a-b/(t+c)^2': (lambda p: p[0]-p[1]/(t+p[2])**2, [7,10,1]),
 'a+b ln t - c/t': (lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*np.log(t)-p[2]/t, [6,1,1]),

 'a-b exp(-k t^2)': (lambda p: p[0]-p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*t**2), [7,4,0.1]),
 'a-b exp(-k sqrt t)': (lambda p: p[0]-p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*np.sqrt(t)), [7,4,0.5]),
 'a - b/(1+c t)^2': (lambda p: p[0]-p[1]/(1+p[2]*t)**2, [7,4,0.5]),
 'a-b exp(-k t)+c t': (lambda p: p[0]-p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*t)+p[3]*t, [7,4,1,0]),
}
